findings.text: The company status is recorded as dissolved, with cessation on 8 April 2014.
The company was incorporated on 20 March 2013 and was 1.1 years old (384 days) at cessation.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts are of unknown overdue status, with no next due date or last made-up date recorded.
The confirmation statement is of unknown overdue status, with no next due date or last made-up date recorded.
The register shows 1 current officer, a director (PERSON 366) appointed on 20 March 2013, and no other officers.
No current person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.
No charges are registered against the company.
